IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman sits in a wooden lounge
chair beside a stacked woodpile and a weathered
plank wall, with light snow on the ground. She
wears a long, cream wool belted coat with a high
funnel collar, a cream knit headband with star
earrings, and cream knit gloves. A soft white fur
throw drapes the chair. Her expression is calm and
direct. Cool, overcast daylight. Palette of cream,
weathered brown, and icy blue. Soft and elegant, in
the style of a winter lookbook.
